jobs.title: Consumer Product Manager
jobs.location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
Consumer Product Manager
Description -
Job Summary
• This role is responsible for shaping organization-wide methods, evaluating and integrating new technologies, innovations, and partnerships, aligning with strategic roadmaps and business value. The role evaluates product designs and project activities, while supervising troubleshooting efforts and instigating design enhancements. The role acts as a functional manager within its realm of expertise, establishing strategy, defining functional policies, and steering the overall direction. The role leverages acknowledged domain proficiency, business insight, and experience to influence decisions.

Responsibilities
• Develops organization-wide architectures and methodologies for product engineering across multiple platforms.
• Identifies and evaluates new technologies, innovations, and outsourced partner relationships for alignment with strategy roadmap and business value.
• Creates plans for integration and update into architecture, while effectively communicating the proposal, and results, and negotiating options at business unit and executive levels.
• Reviews and evaluates product designs and project activities for compliance with manufacturing guidelines and standards.
• Oversees troubleshooting, initiates design improvements and documentation with the R&D, Engineering, and operations teams to achieve continuous improvement.
• Provides tangible feedback based on results to improve product quality and mitigate risk of product failure.
• Contributes innovative ideas, exercising independent judgment to solve unique and complex problems impacting the business.
• Acts as a functional manager within area of expertise, developing strategy and setting functional policy and direction.
• Leverages recognized domain expertise, business acumen, and experience to influence decisions of executive business leadership, outsourced manufacturing and development partners, and industry standards groups.
• Guides and mentors staff members on product engineering design, innovation and excellence.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 10+ years of work experience, preferably in product design & development, or a related field.

Preferred Certifications
NA

Knowledge & Skills
• Agile Methodology
• Application Programming Interface (API)
• Automation
• Business Requirements
• Computer Science
• Data Analysis
• Electrical Engineering
• New Product Development
• Product Design
• Product Engineering
• Product Lifecycle Management
• Product Management
• Product Requirements
• Product Roadmaps
• Product Strategy
• Project Management
• Scrum (Software Development)
• Software Development
• User Experience (UX)
• User Story

Cross-Org Skills
• Effective Communication
• Results Orientation
• Learning Agility
• Digital Fluency
• Customer Centricity

Impact & Scope
• Impacts large functions and leads large, cross-division functional teams or projects.

Complexity
• Provides highly innovative solutions to complex problems within established policy.

Disclaimer
• This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Global Product Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Meyrin, Geneva, Switzerland; Wallisellen, Zurich, Switzerland
jobs.description:
Global Product Marketing Manager
Description -
It’s an amazing time to join HP! Our company was founded in 1939 and considered the birthplace of Silicon Valley. We’ve since grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, serving over 1 billion customers in more than 170 countries. We thrive on transforming customer insights and innovative ideas into extraordinary products and experiences. We are a technology company born of the belief that companies should do more than just make a profit. They should make the world a better place.

Position Overview :
The HP Imaging, Printing & Solutions marketing team is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive demand for printing supplies, including toner and ink cartridges, and printers for everyday use at home, families, and home offices. In this role, you’ll be responsible for the product marketing strategy, translating product capabilities into compelling positioning, messaging, and content that resonate with global customers. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with product management, regional marketing, go-to-market, category, and sales to bring products to market and drive sales.

Responsibilities :
The Global Product Marketing Manager will lead a range of tasks, including:
- Define, write, and test differentiated value propositions for printer supplies and hardware, tailored to relevant customer segments.

- Use in-depth knowledge of customer insights, to create product messaging that resonates with target audiences, and effectively communicates the product’s value.

- Conduct research and testing to understand customer needs, global market trends, and competitive landscapes. Advocate for customer perspective.

- Develop sales tools and enablement materials, such as pitch decks, battlecards, and training materials.

- Provide updates and lead presentations with product management, business partners, and senior leadership to ensure close collaboration and alignment.

- Collaborate with regional marketing teams to ensure global strategy accounts for local market needs and is consistently implemented.

- Oversee messaging and asset reviews with stakeholders and leadership, to ensure consistent, accurate, and on-time delivery.

- Manage agency partners to deliver assets on time and within budget. Own scope, brief, and adherence to timelines and budget. Manage projects end-to-end and deliver approved assets using Adobe Workfront.

- Collaborate with Communications team and other partners on product launches, announcements, and events to support business goals and ensure product strategy is consistent across touchpoints.

- Document and refine processes to ensure alignment with business and regional marketing stakeholders.

- Manage functional budgets and forecasting for assigned product lines.

Knowledge and Skills :
- Strong understanding of product lifecycle management and customer journey mapping.

- Demonstrated skill developing product positioning and messaging end-to end-and effectively manage feedback from cross-functional stakeholders.

- Excellent project management skills with proven experience driving multiple concurrent product launches and initiatives.

- Balance of strategic planning and meticulous execution to ensure consistency on a global scale.

- Strong written and oral communications skills, including presenting and influencing, with senior and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong leadership skills including team building, conflict resolution and consensus-building, in a highly matrixed, global organization. Ability to influence and lead virtual teams and interface effectively with all levels of management and cross-functional disciplines.

- Strategic thinker with a bias for action and results orientation and pragmatic approach to managing obstacles – someone who always finds a way to “get it done.”

- Passionate, driven, dependable, and transformational – a real change agent.

- Flexibility to regularly meet virtually with colleagues from around the world in different time zones and occasionally travel globally.

Education and Experience Required :
- Four-year or Graduate Degree in Marketing or Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

- 7-10+ years of work experience, preferably in product marketing, sales enablement, go-to-market strategy, customer research, product management, at a global technology hardware or consumer goods company.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management - Displays Solutions
jobs.location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
Senior Director of Product Management - Displays Solutions
Description -
At HP we imagine the future and make it happen. We love transforming customer insights and innovative new ideas into extraordinary products and experiences to lead in the market. We believe that each employee contributes to making a meaningful difference in the lives of our customers.

In the Displays Solutions Business we are continuously driving strategies for how to deliver new innovations and solutions to enhance customer experiences across our workspace portfolio. We spend countless hours diving intimately into our customers’ requirements and future needs, understanding future trends and evaluating new technologies – so that we can define and deliver ground-breaking new experiences for our customers.

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Displays Solutions team. The ideal candidate who is passionate about customers, have a strong background in product management, a deep understanding of display technologies, and a proven track record of driving product innovation and market success. This leader will be responsible for defining and executing the product and solutions strategy, managing the product lifecycle, and leading a team of product managers to deliver exceptional display solutions that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute the product strategy for Displays Solutions, aligning with overall business objectives and market trends.

- Lead and mentor a team of product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Drive the insights to innovation process and develop deep customer and market insights, market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product and experience decisions.

- Oversee the entire solutions product lifecycle, from ideation and development to launch and post-launch optimization.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, marketing, product design, downstream go-to-market organizations sales, and other complementary ecosystem product organizations to ensure successful product definition, development and launch.

- Define and prioritize product experiences, features and requirements, balancing customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.

- Monitor product performance and customer feedback, using data-driven insights to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

- Work jointly with our downstream partner organizations to establish business goals, track business performance and create opportunities to drive new business growth initiatives.

- Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings to promote Displays Solutions and gather market intelligence.

- Lead and drive executive communications and presentations on our portfolio leadership strategies

- Create strong relationships across the ecosystem industry to influence Displays Solutions roadmaps with key industry partners

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

- 10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

- Exceptional ability to work across diverse teams and gain alignment on priorities for challenging business problems

- Strong knowledge of display technologies and the display solutions market.

- Software, solutions and experiences planning expertise

- Proven track record of successfully launching and managing products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Proven track record for creating industry-recognized innovations

- Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to think strategically and execute tactically.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Exceptional business acumen and strong understanding of business line financials

- Ability to travel internationally and domestically as needed

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

The base pay range for this role is $183.650 - 293,800 annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to US candidates only).  Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Portfolio & Product Management
jobs.location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Portfolio & Product Management
Description -
About HP
At HP, we deliver the world’s most secure and manageable PCs—trusted by governments, defense organizations, and global enterprises. In a landscape where cybersecurity threats are evolving rapidly and targeting organizations from every angle, our solutions provide layered, comprehensive protection. We empower businesses with robust security that is simple to deploy, manage, and customize—without compromising usability.

Why Join HP?
Join a company that’s redefining the future of work, security, and innovation. At HP, you’ll have the opportunity to lead at the forefront of PC security and make a tangible impact on millions of customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
As HP continues to lead the market in secure and manageable PCs, we are seeking an accomplished Senior Director of Portfolio & Product Management to drive the strategic direction of our Commercial PC Security portfolio. This portfolio encompasses cutting-edge security technologies across hardware, firmware, software, and services.

In this high-impact leadership role, you will oversee the Portfolio & Product Management function within HP’s Security Business Unit. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, shaping product strategy, and collaborating across multiple business units to execute on a shared vision. You will partner with engineering, product marketing, program management, and category teams to ensure delivery of compelling, differentiated solutions that address the most pressing security needs of our customers.

Key Responsibilities
- Build, develop, and lead a high-performing Security Product Management team

- Define and drive the product vision and multi-year strategy for the Commercial PC Security portfolio

- Translate market trends, customer needs, and field feedback into strategic priorities and product roadmaps

- Foster alignment across HP’s ecosystem, working closely with cross-functional teams in Hardware, Solutions, Digital Services, and Sales

- Evaluate strategic growth opportunities, including partnerships and acquisitions, and develop business cases to support investments

- Manage product portfolio planning and roadmap execution in collaboration with Engineering and Program Management

- Serve as the voice of the security product strategy in executive communications, internal forums, and customer engagements

- Cultivate and manage key partnerships with external technology vendors, including licensing and integration strategy

- Support customer-facing teams with technical positioning and messaging that highlight HP’s security differentiation

What We’re Looking For
- 10+ years of Product Management experience, with 5+ years in cybersecurity, enterprise manageability, or related security domains

- Proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

- Deep understanding of the full product lifecycle and experience delivering solutions that span hardware, software, and services

- Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and analytical skills

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level influence

- Ability to navigate complex technical environments and make data-driven decisions

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

Disclaimer
This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

The base pay range for this role is $192,800-$289,200 annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to US candidates only).  Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: VP, Portfolio & Product Management ACS
jobs.location: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States of America; Spring, Texas, United States of America; Palo Alto, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
VP, Portfolio & Product Management ACS
Description -
The Role : The VP, Product & Portfolio Management in Advanced Compute Solutions is responsible for the overall lifecycle of ACS core hardware products, which includes the HP Workstation portfolio.

Summary: Responsible for driving the overall vision, roadmap, and product-market fit for HP's workstation products, with a strong focus on disciplined product lifecycle management and successful new product introductions. This role is accountable for delivering profitable growth while maintaining sustained HP differentiation across the product portfolio. Additionally, it involves creating go-to-market messaging and training materials, and managing ongoing engagement with Category teams and regional markets to ensure alignment and execution.

This position is committed to understanding and addressing market/customer leads, driving a team of product management professionals, as well as collaborating with customers, alliance partners and internal stakeholders to ensure coordinated execution in all matters of product management. This person is an excellent leader and communicator, as well as a developer of product management talent within and across product lines.

Key responsibilities:
- Responsible for life cycle management of the product/services/solutions (PSS) lines from development, launch, refresh to obsolescence.

- Accountable for leading ACS Product and Portfolio Management organization by setting overall initiatives, allocating financial and human capital for programs and projects, and ensuring timely and effective delivery of product, solutions, and services marketing programs.

- Defines and continually refines the product roadmap, synthesizing customer insights, market input, technology roadmaps, and all initiatives for operational excellence.

- Strategy development and thought leadership: demonstrate advanced knowledge in the domain of expertise in defining a strategy to win – the ‘why HP’ drivers of differentiation and scale.

- Responsible for Customer Journey Mapping process to ensure we are delivering important and meaningful customer value across the portfolio.  This will include close collaboration with the ACS Solutions team to ensure the overall product/software/solution offering delivers differentiated value to customers.

- Plan and deliver on portfolio which includes all core HW and product experiences, requiring strong collaboration with SW/solutions/services partners inside and outside of ACS and aligned with the strategy to win in the market.

- Requires strong and close collaboration with the PS Commercial business to ensure we continue to deliver consistent commercial capabilities across our workstation portfolio.

- Monitors market trends, analyzes competitors’ offerings, and solicits input from customers, partners, sales teams for product planning and design.

- Provides thought-leadership on new ACS core hardware offerings as well as refreshes.

- Responsible for long–term business forecasting and marketing budget recommendations.

- Coordinates creation of training materials and regularly evangelizes key value propositions both internally and externally.

- Leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of systems, procedures, and policies; identifies consequences of decisions on a global level and recommends appropriate solutions and areas for improvement.

- Consults with business leaders at the L2 and L1 levels to drive and influence strategic decision-making within a broad scope (e.g., mitigating risk, approving significant programs/deals).

- Ensures that the marketing strategies and initiatives within area of accountability are integrated with corporate and business strategies.

- May be responsible for significant dotted-line employee reporting relationships.

Education and Experience Required:
- First level university degree with a focus in Marketing, Business, or Engineering; advanced degree strongly preferred.

- Typically, 12+ years of experience in product marketing or exhibiting an exceptionally strong background in some other relevant and applicable area of business.

- Preferred 8+ years of people management experience.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Strong communication skills with a particular focus on the ability to communicate with and synthesize insights from customers, IT decision makers, and channel partners.

- Excellent ability to provide HPS/ACS product marketing recommendations to senior managers within area of expertise.

- Understanding of the workstation  business, customer verticals, and RTM segments (enterprise, SMB, Public Sector, and etail)

- Deep understanding of industry trends and business unit to create a value proposition for the business unit and a product vision

- Ability to clearly communicate strategy and complex concepts, ideas, and alternatives

- Strong analytical skills, structured thinking and problem-solving skills to direct team and key partners on strategic priorities for the business

- Superior understanding of product design and current product management.

- In-depth experience working with Sales, Category, Marketing, R&D and customers.

- Strong ability to influence for results across business and function boundaries

- Excellent project management and prioritization skills.

- Excellent people management skills, including managing teams across geographies.

- Strong ability to build relationships and strong partnerships with internal and external partners

- Excellent consulting, influencing, and negotiation skills.

​ The pay range for this role is $ 250k to $350k USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
